text:
Suspected bandits have killed a prominent Islamic cleric, Sheikh Yahaya Masussuka, and his associate in Dutsin-Ma Local Government Area of Katsina State.
The attack occurred at about 9 pm on Monday at the entrance to the cleric’s residence in Dutsin-Ma town, where the assailants reportedly opened fire on the two men. The victims were rushed to Dutsin-Ma Hospital for emergency medical attention but were later confirmed dead.
The killing has thrown the community into mourning, particularly followers of the cleric and residents who knew him.
As of the time of filing this report, details about the identity of the attackers and the motive behind the killing remained unclear.
The Katsina State Police Command has confirmed the death of the Islamic scholar.
It was also gathered that Sheikh Masussuka had planned to organise a religious gathering in Katsina State later this week.
The late cleric had previously been involved in controversies over his religious teachings.
On November 18, 2025, the Katsina State Government announced that he would be required to defend his teachings before a committee of Islamic scholars.
However, there was no indication as of press time that the earlier controversy was connected to Monday night’s killing.
The police had yet to provide further details on the circumstances of the attack or announce any arrests as of press time.
